item: A member that opens a nested statement deadline is still stopped by its own, pinned through the real zip job
summary: Drives _write_all_diagnostics_zip on a real pooled engine: a DB member that opens a nested statement_deadline, waits past its own deadline and starts a long statement is recorded skipped-deadline. On main the statement ran to the end and the member shipped as partial-deadline with its payload (bundle.py member loop, the all-diagnostics job; no request path nests, measured). Red against main's maintenance.py, green with the restore of the enclosing handler (dd441dc42).
